method: Written by hand from each repo's files at the pinned commit, without looking at any Refit output. Every tracked manifest, lockfile, Dockerfile, CI file and source file of the demo repos was read; for the five upgrade-dev-20 repos every manifest, CI file and import list was read. Dates come from the pinned endoflife.date and nodejs/Release files, vendor pages or OSV, quoted in each finding. Only the transitive lists are generated, from each repo's own lockfile.

rules.dependencies: required: runtimes, frameworks, direct runtime dependencies, AI models, container images, GitHub Actions and runners, infrastructure files, and the regulated surfaces of demo-next-web. acceptable (neither credit nor penalty): dev and optional dependencies, other CI systems, cloud services named only through SDKs, and every transitive lockfile name.
rules.findings: required: a runtime, framework, Lambda runtime, Kubernetes API, AI model or CI action or runner past end of life or retired; an advisory on a direct runtime dependency whose fix is outside the declared range; the three planted rule flaws in demo-next-web. acceptable: other majors, in-range advisories, dev-only and CI-service items. A finding matches a label clause when its dependency name equals an alias, or starts with an alias followed by ':', '@' or '/', and its kind is listed (when kinds are given) and its title matches (when a title pattern is given). A second row matching the same label is a duplicate.
rules.ci: Each repo's own test CI at the pinned commit was checked with the GitHub API on 2026-11-08: no repo has a failing test run there. demo-next-web's 'test' check passed; records-mover's only failing run at that commit is GitHub code scanning (CodeQL default setup), and its last test runs (2026-09-30) passed; capone's failures are Dependabot update jobs; the rest have no runs at that commit, so their baseline is unknown, not failing.
